project_name: Character model sheet, 4 turnaround views showing front, back, three-quarters, and side profile in one image of Pierre Mercier, 22-year-old Monégasque racing prodigy. Sleek straight blonde hair with sharp side-parting, cool piercing crystal-blue eyes, refined aristocratic jawline, calm composed stoic expression. Wearing a tailored bone-white and royal cobalt-blue racing suit with platinum thread embroidery and geometric trim, white racing gloves, polished white racing boots. Holding a minimalist pearl-white GT3 racing helmet with platinum geometric crest under his arm. Crisp cel-shaded anime style, thick black manga ink outlines, halftone Ben-Day dot shading, sharp geometric shadows, neutral grey studio background
